method: Same existing binary; 20 s baseline, 40 s HTTP-only then 40 s Paseo-only, 45 s cooldown. Perf records all allocation API entry sizes and SAME-TID selected function entry/exit events in short windows, no full-stack streaming. No lost events or misnested exits in accepted windows. DWARF stacks from excluded first run are only path hints.

excluded_runs.06-profile-short: Full DWARF record grew past 128 MiB budget; driver stopped this diagnostic only. Numerous PERF_RECORD_LOST, not used for byte fractions or memory acceptance. Its valid symbolized stacks identify candidate paths only.
excluded_runs.07-scope-short: perf auto-suffixed return-event names; recording failed before pressure. Not accepted. Own leftover return definitions were removed; fixed run validates actual event existence before starting.
